lines: I still <pulse>remember</pulse> you trying to take my {stolen_stack}.
That {stolen_item} from the {stolen_container}? I have not forgotten.
You put your hands on village stores once. I am <pulse>watching</pulse> them now.
Trust is counted in small things. Last time, it was counted in {stolen_stack}.
I remember the {stolen_container}, the missing {stolen_item}, and your face beside both.
If you came to make right with the {stolen_item}, start by keeping your hands visible.
The {stolen_stack} was not yours, and pretending otherwise will not help you here.
I keep my things closer now. You can guess why.
A stolen {stolen_item} leaves more behind than an empty space.
Speak if you need to, but understand why I am still <shake>careful</shake>.

<aqua>{theft_witness_possessive}</aqua> <shake>warning</shake> reached more doors than you opened.

A theft from one villager has a way of reaching every counter in the village.
